verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own docs say you can manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack, and its pricing page lists a chat experience in Slack and Microsoft Teams. A community user also mentions acknowledging pages from Slack. Incident Workflows add automated response logic, but nothing ties them to creating chat channels or assigning roles. missing for 10: explicit evidence of declaring an incident from a chat command, automatic incident channel creation, responder role assignment in chat, automated status updates posted to chat, Teams-specific detail, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me

citations.quote: Manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack or your IDE.
Chat experience in Slack and Microsoft Teams
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
Incident Workflows allow you to build an automated response for every incident.
